quote: From Prospecting 20 Stacks of Elementium Ore
notes: Original independent firsthand comment by user 724811 (signing Doc, Azjol-Nerub) reports prospecting 20 stacks of Elementium Ore and directly lists this gem total. Twenty stacks are nominally 400 ore / 80 five-ore equivalents if each stack was full; exact completed clicks and refunds were NOT logged, so casts, positive-hit count, zero outcomes and per-click histogram are unknown. A later commenter 456721 gives a combined 260-prospect table involving this 20-stack report, the separately recorded 25-stack Fawnish cohort (misattributed to jjhilly in prior evidence), and their own separately recorded 20-stack/80-prospect report. DO NOT count the combined table as independent or attribute Fawnish's totals to this author. Historical Cataclysm observations, patch and skill unspecified; not current Retail rate proof.
